title: Austin: Free Rides, Tax Breaks, and Trailer Troubles
summary:
*   The city approved funding to support a community canning program.
*   Residents petitioned for the complete removal of a trailer camp on East 2nd Street, which was taken under advisement.
*   Permission was granted for free transportation services for delegates attending a convention at the Olivet Baptist Church.
*   The city council remitted penalties and half (or all, in one case) of the accrued interest for several individuals and businesses with long-standing delinquent property taxes.

WHEREAS, the City of Austin taxes for the years 1932 through 1940 on personal property in

in the amount of $145.72 has accrued, making the total amount of taxes, penalty and
interest due $442.21; and WHEREAS, the City Council of the City of Austin deems it just
and equitable to remit said penalty in the sum of $14.11 and one-half of the inter- est in
the sum of $72.86; therefore, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN:
THAT the aforesaid penalty in the sum of $14.11 and one-half of the interest in the sum of
$72.86 are hereby remitted, and the Tax Assessor and Collector of the City of Austin is
hereby authorized and directed to charge said penalty in the sum of $14.11 and said
interest in the sum of $72.86 off his rolls, and to issue to the party entitled to receive
same a receipt in full upon payment of the taxes and one-half of the interest as
aforesaid. vote: Upon motion, the foregoing resolution was adopted by the following Ayes:
Councilmen Alford, Bartholomew, Gillis, Mayor Miller Noes : None
